description: What changed in a city index over the last days: findings fixed or new, grades up or down, AI crawlers turned away or let in, direct booking or ordering channels and vendors gained or lost, and assistants that changed their answer about a business. Each change links the business's report. Also a page (https://directindex.org/city/{slug}/changes), an Atom feed (/changes.xml) and JSON (/api/city/{slug}/changes?days=30).

city.description: City slug, for example lisbon; see list_cities

You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.
